meta.estimator: LPDiD (Dube, Girardi, Jorda & Taylor 2025) - complex survey (Phase D2)
meta.record_format: Each horizon / pooled row is c(estimate, SE, df, n_psu) for the tdiff coefficient.
meta.se_convention: survey::svyglm Binder (1983) Taylor-linearization sandwich. df = degf(design): n_PSU - n_strata (strata present, VW/covariate) or n_PSU - 1 (weights-only inject). Each horizon uses a FRESH svydesign over THAT horizon's clean LP-DiD long-difference sample (NOT subset() of a full design) - matching the library's per-sample resolution.
meta.clean_sample_xcheck: Clean-sample construction independently validated: the UNWEIGHTED VW event study (same prep/clean_h recipe) matches alexCardazzi::lpdid() to <1e-8. Selection is weight-independent, so this transitively validates the weighted svyglm samples.
meta.point_gate: Every svyglm WLS point validated == weighted feols(.. | time, weights, vcov=~unit) on the same sample to <1e-7.
meta.fpc_note: fpc is the per-stratum population PSU count (f_h = n_PSU_h / fpc_h); decoupled from the inverse-selection weight.
